title: Learn Attan In Three Easy Steps

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains the structure of the dance verbally before demonstrating each step clearly from a front-facing perspective. He breaks down movements into specific step categories and practices them repeatedly with counting.

lesson_structure.note: Instructor introduces himself and the dance tutorial
Explains the breakdown of steps into 7 parts with three main steps
Practices all steps along with music

steps_taught.name: First three steps
steps_taught.description: Basic side step movement repeated three times

steps_taught.name: Full round
steps_taught.description: Putting left foot in front of right and turning fully

steps_taught.name: Half turn
steps_taught.description: Putting right foot in front of left and turning half

what_works: Clear breakdown of steps and numbers before practice
what_hinders: Camera angle and framing make full footwork hard to see at times

quotes.text: Today I'm going to show you how to do Attan.
All you have to do is just concentrate on what I'm doing.
I hope this video is workable for you people.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor talking to camera sitting down
Instructor demonstrating step one moving arms and feet

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down the tutorial into specific numerical step categories and repetition counts upfront before execution.
